<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 141.115 Da, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral exact mass of 140.108 Da. The best‑matching elemental composition for this exact mass, consistent with the observed ~9 % M+1 intensity (≈8 % from 13C), is C₈H₁₄NO (exact mass 140.1076 Da, error ≈ 0.5 mDa). Therefore the molecular formula in the required format is C8H14O0N.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O0N</final_answer>
